title: APPROVAL OF AGREEMENT WITH ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT CORPORATION OF LOS ANGELES COUNTY FOR ECONOMIC IMPACT ANALYSIS SERVICES
text:
RESOLUTION NO. ____________ - APPROVAL OF AGREEMENT WITH ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT CORPORATION OF LOS ANGELES COUNTY FOR ECONOMIC IMPACT ANALYSIS SERVICES
Transmittal 1
Transmittal 2
Summary
: Staff requests approval of an Agreement with the Economic Development Corporation of Los Angeles County (LAEDC) to conduct a comprehensive economic impact analysis of waterborne trade traversing the San Pedro Bay Ports Complex. The analysis will quantify the jobs, wages, tax revenues, and economic activity generated by trade through the Ports of Los Angeles and Long Beach, and will disaggregate those results by political subdivision, from City Council Districts to all 435 Congressional Districts and all 50 states. The recommendation to select LAEDC is based on a competitive Request for Proposal (RFP). The proposed Agreement is for a one-year term with a not-to-exceed amount of $292,000. The proposed action is aligned with the City of Los Angeles (City) Harbor Department’s (Harbor Department) Strategic Plan, Objective 4: Strong Relationships with Stakeholders. The Harbor Department is financially responsible for payment of expenses incurred under the proposed Agreement.
Recommendation
: Board resolve to 1) find that the Director of Environmental Management has determined that the proposed action is administratively exempt from the requirements of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) under Article II Section 2(f) of the Los Angeles City CEQA Guidelines; 2) find that in accordance with the Los Angeles City Charter (Charter), Section 1022, work under the proposed Agreement is temporary in nature and can be performed more feasibly by an independent contractor than by City employees; 3) approve the proposed Agreement with LAEDC for a one-year term with a not-to-exceed amount of $292,000; 4) authorize the Executive Director to execute, and the Board Secretary to attest to, the proposed Agreement for and on behalf of the Board; and 5) adopt Resolution No. ______________.
